actions.sensitive_topic_wording_note: Reserved, not enforced at runtime. It declares that customer-facing wording on these topics comes from a pre-approved template rather than free generation, because a fluent invented sentence about a refund or a contract is a commitment the company then owes. No code reads this field yet: enforcing it needs a template store and a topic classifier, and a classifier deciding whether a message is about refunds would be a model placed on a deterministic branch. Skills cite it as a boundary; wire it to an enforcement point before treating it as one.

connectors.default_mode_note: Reserved, not enforced at runtime. This release has no outbound write path for a mode check to gate: BaseChannelAdapter.send_approved always raises and every adapter disables REPLY_SEND. Wire this field to an enforcement point before relying on it.
